answer: Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, no identity may audit its own recruit. The horizon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quartz is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
